t.zh: 一张新地图：机器人只能往右或往下走。宝藏 10，地图边上一圈是悬崖，−10。
t.en: A new map: the robot can only go right or down. The treasure is worth 10, and the edge of the map is a ring of cliffs at −10.

t.zh: 每一格的价值 = 往右、往下两格里较好的那个，打个九折。
t.en: Each cell’s value = the better of the cells to the right and below, discounted to 90%.

goal.zh: 算出每一格的价值：往右、往下两格里较好的那个 × 0.9。
goal.en: Work out the value of every cell: the better of right and down × 0.9.

how.zh: 机器人一轮一轮地扫，直到表不再变。答案看起点那一格。
how.en: The robot scans in rounds until the table stops changing. The answer is the start cell.

body.zh: 只有两个方向，每一格都只看右边和下面。
body.en: With two directions, every cell looks only right and down.

say.zh: 这张地图上只能往右或往下走：上面和左边走不过去。
say.en: On this map you only move right or down: up and left can’t be reached.

hints.zh: 只能往右或往下：右边、下面接进「取较大」，再乘 0.9。
hints.en: Right or down only: wire right and down into a max, then multiply by 0.9.
